status: accepted architecture and acceptance wording; no product completion or native gate inferred

existing_source_review.note: Use the corrected canonical review, which distinguishes storing original claims/signatures from current cryptographic authentication by Agentd. The earlier scratch RECOVERY_REVIEW.md is superseded for publication.

accepted_semantics.result: The target preserves App Server as the only model/session/tool execution spine, Agentd as composition/lifecycle host, and one authoritative schema owner/writer per durable domain. It grants no new execution, writer, selection, promotion or release authority.

RunStart stores immutable original claims/signatures. Agentd require_current_run_start performs current signature, epoch and fence validation. LedgerWriter retains typed authenticated Decision/Outcome append ownership.

A post-preparation signed handoff requires an additional typed record and verified reader under the declared owner, with a binding to immutable RunStart. The target does not allow rewriting RunStart or adding an Agentd fact store.

Default canonical_ready is described as preparation/transient admission. The optional legacy in-memory pending carrier is distinguished from the missing default App Server handoff, authenticated Decision/Outcome composition and process-loss recovery.

Kill points require recovery of the original signed request and original operation identity; uncertain effects are reconciled without redispatch. Real terminal evidence, witness recovery, expiry/revocation and corrupted-history cases remain explicit gates.

Strong baselines, matched information/budget, controller-generator comparisons and interaction, complete chosen/unchosen/failed execution and training costs, new holdout evidence and valid no-update outcomes remain required.

Sealed qualification and current-use source properties are not presented as efficacy or effect authority. Production providers, publication sink, complete receipt persistence/readback and current-owner signatures remain separate dependencies.
A complete handoff receipt must establish actual consumer cutover, new-writer readiness, fencing, migration, drain and rollback viability. A plan alone is not activation completion.

Control owns its lifecycle records; each domain writer owns its handoff/outbox/acknowledgements. Shared lifecycle coordination does not assert one atomic distributed transaction or create a second Agentd writer.

The document preserves exact-head and ordered merge-candidate CI, original Windows attacks, real provider/effect acceptance, restart trials, independent efficacy and release gates. Queued, skipped or compile-failed jobs cannot satisfy them.

changes_requested_and_verified: Distinguish durable storage of claims/signatures from Agentd current cryptographic authorization.

Keep source truth outside learned parameters and include actual execution costs.
